product_overview: An AI-powered email client that lets authenticated users connect a Google inbox, browse and manage email threads, search across mail, and get AI assistance for understanding and drafting messages. The app also supports account switching, subscription status viewing, and theme customization.
core_goals: Sign in to access the mail client
Connect a Google email account to sync inbox data
Browse folders and read email threads in a three-pane mail view
Search through synced emails to find messages quickly
Ask AI questions about email content and receive helpful responses
Compose new emails and reply to existing threads
View subscription status and upgrade the plan
Toggle between light and dark themes

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can sign in or sign up through Clerk to access protected areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter authentication details -> Complete sign in -> Land on the authenticated home or mail experience

features.name: Link Google Email Account
features.description: Users can connect a Google inbox so the app can sync and display email data.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose to connect a Google account -> Complete Google consent -> Return to the app and see the account linked and syncing begin

features.name: Mail Inbox Dashboard
features.description: Users can browse mailbox folders, inspect threads, and read messages in the main three-pane mail layout.
user_flows: Navigate to /mail -> View the three-pane inbox layout -> Switch between inbox folders or tabs -> Select an email thread -> Read the message content in the reading pane
Navigate to /mail -> View the inbox layout -> Toggle a thread between inbox and done state -> See the thread move to the appropriate state
Navigate to /mail -> View the sidebar navigation -> Collapse the sidebar -> Expand the sidebar again

features.name: Account Switching
features.description: Users can move between linked email accounts from within the mail interface.
user_flows: Navigate to /mail -> Open the account switcher -> Select a different linked account -> See the thread list refresh for that account

features.name: Email Search
features.description: Users can search across synced email content to find relevant messages.
user_flows: Navigate to /mail -> Focus the search input -> Type a search query -> View matching results -> Clear the search to return to the normal thread list
Navigate to /mail -> Open search with the keyboard shortcut -> Enter a query -> Review the filtered email results

features.name: Ask AI Chat
features.description: Users can ask AI questions about their email history and get streamed responses based on email context.
user_flows: Navigate to /mail -> Open the Ask AI panel -> Choose a suggested prompt -> Read the streamed response
Navigate to /mail -> Open the Ask AI panel -> Type a custom question -> Submit the question -> Read the streamed AI response
Navigate to /mail -> Open the Ask AI panel -> Ask enough questions to exceed the free quota -> See a daily limit notice

features.name: Compose and Reply Email
features.description: Users can create new emails or respond to existing threads using the rich text email editor.
user_flows: Navigate to /mail -> Open a new email draft -> Enter recipients, subject, and message body -> Send the email
Navigate to /mail -> Open an existing thread -> Open the reply editor -> Expand recipient and subject details if needed -> Write a reply -> Send the response
Navigate to /mail -> Open a new email draft -> Use AI assistance to draft content -> Review the suggested text -> Send the email

features.name: Subscription and Billing
features.description: Users can review their current plan and start an upgrade checkout flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /mail -> Open the billing or plan section -> Review the current plan and usage limits
Navigate to /mail -> Open the billing or plan section -> Start the upgrade process -> Proceed through Stripe checkout

features.name: Theme Toggle
features.description: Users can switch the interface between light and dark appearance modes.
user_flows: Navigate to /mail -> Use the theme toggle control -> Observe the interface switch to the other theme -> Use the toggle again to switch back

routes.description: Landing/onboarding page that prompts connecting a Google account, or redirects to /mail if accounts exist
Main email client dashboard with sidebar, thread list, thread display, search, compose, and Ask AI

known_limitations.issue: App requires Clerk authentication and a linked Google account via Aurinko before most mail features work
known_limitations.impact: Unauthenticated or unlinked users cannot exercise inbox search compose or Ask AI flows

known_limitations.issue: Dev server is single-threaded and may be less stable under concurrent TestSprite load than production mode
known_limitations.impact: TestSprite may limit to 15 high-priority tests while npm run dev is used
